content: नट् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (नटति, the न not changed to ण after प्र in the sense of ‘hurting’.) .²1 To dance; यदि मनसा नटनीयम् <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>. .²2 To act. .²3 To injure (by a deceptive trick). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (नाटयति-ते) .²1 To act, gesticulate, represent dramatically (in dramas); शरसंधानं नाटयति <ls>Ś. 1</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To imitate, copy; स्फटिककटकभूमिर्नाटयत्येष शैलः … अधिगतधवलिम्नः शूलपाणेरभिख्याम् <ls>Śi. 4. 65</ls>. ({%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} नट् forms नटयति in the sense of ‘causing to dance’; नाट्येन केन नटयिष्यति दीर्घमायुः <ls>Bh. 3. 126.</ls>). --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (नाटयति-ते) .²1 To drop or fall. .²2 To shine. .²3 To injure.
